scope: Transfer assortment, exact product identity, recipient outcome and duplicate-stock prevention after the two client videos from 2026-11-01.
authorization: Human explicitly requested implementation and publication directly in main. Physical counts are unavailable; human explicitly requested a reconciliation sheet and no customer stock changes.
domainDecisions: A transfer credits the exact source product and variant; a matching name never establishes product identity.

Physical stock and sale assortment are separate. New application forms require sale availability, or an explicit inventory-only acknowledgement bound to the reviewed destination, lines and quantities.
Checked posting validates actual recipient availability inside the stock transaction. A conflict rolls back both legs, stock lots and assignments.
Existing integrations and document corrections retain their previous contract when no destinationAssortment mode is supplied.

Selected assortment preparation uses the actual original catalog, existing signed previews, authorization, serializable apply and idempotency. A disabled ALL source is reopened only for explicitly selected goods.
Explicit local hiding, unrelated connections, other stores, local prices, zero prices and financial history are preserved.
Checked transfers share the assortment policy read lock with sales; independent readers do not serialize. Configuration writers retain their existing exclusive lock.
delivered: Actionable assortment warning before a new transfer; authorized selected-product connection with preview and retry.
Explicit inventory-only posting when recipient goods must remain unavailable for sale.
Posted movement detail shows exact recipient cards, current balances, availability and scoped inventory links.
Batched, store-scoped same-name candidate balances in transfers and posted outcome; warning in inline and individual adjustment editors. No automatic merging or stock changes.
Original-source guidance and duplicate reconciliation instructions in Russian, Kyrgyz and English help content.

Existing two-column workflow, order, proportions, product picker and action positions retained. Desktop line content has a readable minimum width and scrolls within the right column. Mobile retains its existing stacked workflow.

referencePlatforms.applied: Separate receipt, product activation and location-specific inventory impacts.
Preserve item identity and paired source/destination stock movement.
Explicit ICU collation for Unicode candidate normalization; verified on the disposable PostgreSQL and by a scoped production read-only check.

Five failures were caused by C-locale Unicode search in the disposable database; re-created only that test database with ICU and all affected tests passed. One source-format expectation was restored by removing unrelated formatting. Later rebuilds exposed a shared-node_modules symlink problem in temporary standalone output: project dependencies restored offline with the same lockfile, temporary output removed, and build dependencies cloned into an independent directory. No production/customer changes.
